name: Domain Twig
description: Provides a Twig function to get the current active domain (Domain module) inside templates.
project_description: Domain Twig registers a single Twig function, domain(), that returns the current active domain entity from the drupal/domain module's domain negotiator, or NULL when no domain is active. Templates can read the active domain's id, hostname, label, URL and other properties and branch on them without a preprocess hook. The module has no configuration, permissions, routes, or schema; it exposes one twig.extension service (DomainTwigExtension) wired to the domain.negotiator service.
